title: Andy Taylor, versatile guitarist for Duran Duran, dies at 65
summary_full: Andy Taylor was an architect of Duran Duran's signature sound, which blended disco and rock on 1980s hits such as “Hungry Like the Wolf,” “Rio” and “The Reflex.”
